## Data wrangling

```{r}
#| label: load-data

#Read in the data
climate <- read.csv("raw-data/climate-change.csv", skip = 3)
co2 <- read.csv("raw-data/co2-emissions(co2-emissions).csv", skip = 3)
 
#assigned the names of the first row to row names
#removed an unnecessary column
climate <- climate|>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)|>
  select(-"Indicator Code") 
co2 <- co2 |>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)|>
  select(-"Indicator Code")
 
```
 

```{r}
#| label: climate-data

#Load country-data from rnaturalearth and select relevant columns
region <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  #Replace missing country codes (Norway and France)
  mutate(iso_a3 = ifelse(iso_a3 == "-99", iso_a3_eh, iso_a3)) |>  
  select(iso_a3, region_un, sovereignt) |>  #UN region classification
  rename(`Country Code` = iso_a3, `Country Name` = sovereignt)

#created a vector with variables of interest
variables <- 
  c("Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)", 
              "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)",
              "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)",
              "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
              "Population growth (annual %)", 
              "Forest area (% of land area)")

#filtered observations with variables of interest
climate <- climate |>
  filter(`Indicator Name` %in% variables)|>
  right_join(region, by = c("Country Code"))

#remove duplicated column after merging geometry data and rename the original 
climate <- climate |>
  select(-"Country Name.y") |>
  rename(`Country Name` = `Country Name.x`)
```  

```{r}
#| label: co2-data

#Merging existing dataset with the region data and coordinates for plotting
co2_cleaned <- co2 |>
  #Convert all year columns to numeric
  mutate(across(matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}$"), as.numeric)) |>
  #Pivot longer: create one row per Year and Value
 pivot_longer(!c(`Country Name`, `Country Code`, `Indicator Name`), 
              names_to  = "Year",
              values_to = "co2conc" ) |> 
# Cap co2conc at 500 % to avoid outliers
  mutate(co2conc = pmin(co2conc, 500)) |> 
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year)) 

#This results in the creation of Country Name X and Coutry Name Y columns
co2_map <- co2_cleaned |>
 right_join(region, by = "Country Code")

#remove duplicated column after merging geometry data and rename the original 
co2_map <- co2_map |>
  select(-"Country Name.y") |>
  rename(`Country Name` = `Country Name.x`) 

```

```{r}
co2_map <- co2_map |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = co2conc) |>
  select(-39)|>
  mutate(`1990` = 0)|>
  #Convert all year columns to numeric
  mutate(across(matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}$"), ~ as.numeric(.))) 


data <- rbind(co2_map, climate)

#combine yearly median data by continent
climate_medians <- data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}$"),
    names_to = "period",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  #Group countries my region, period and variable of interest
  group_by(region_un, `Indicator Name`, period) |>
    #find the median value per continent
  summarise(median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # Pivot wider to get columns for each period
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = period,
    #assign the name "_median" to each variable
    names_glue = "{period}_median", 
    values_from = median_value
  )
#Join back to original data
data <- data |>
  left_join(climate_medians, by = c("region_un", "Indicator Name")) |>
  distinct()

# Save the dataset
write_rds(data, "Data/data.rds")
```

``` {r}
#| label: kmeans-clustering

climate1 <- climate |>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)|>
  select(-"Indicator Code") 

# vector for selected variables of interest
sustain_indicators <- c(
  "Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)",
  "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
  "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)",
  "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)")

# setting up first period data frame (year 1990)
sustainability1990 <- climate1 |>
    filter(`Indicator Name` %in% sustain_indicators) |>
    select(`Country Name`, `Country Code`, `Indicator Name`, `1990`) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = `Indicator Name`, 
                values_from = `1990`) |>
    drop_na()

# setting up second period data frame (year 2015)
sustainability2015 <- climate1 |>
    filter(`Indicator Name` %in% sustain_indicators) |>
    select(`Country Name`, `Country Code`, `Indicator Name`, `2015`) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = `Indicator Name`, 
                values_from = `2015`) |>
    drop_na()

# standardize the indicator values for 1990
sustain_1990_std <- sustainability1990 |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric)
                , ~ (.x - mean(.x)) / sd(.x)
                , .names = "{.col}_z")) |>
  select(ends_with("_z"))

# standardize the indicator values for 2015
sustain_2015_std <- sustainability2015 |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric)
                , ~ (.x - mean(.x)) / sd(.x)
                , .names = "{.col}_z")) |>
  select(ends_with("_z"))

# run k-means clustering
set.seed(231)

# first, elbow plots for each year's standardized data
elbow_1990 <- tibble(k = 1:10) |>
  mutate(
    kmeans_results = map(k, ~kmeans(sustain_1990_std, .x, nstart = 20)),
    glanced = map(kmeans_results, glance)
  ) |>
  unnest(cols = c(glanced))
elbow_2015 <- tibble(k = 1:10) |>
  mutate(
    kmeans_results = map(k, ~kmeans(sustain_2015_std, .x, nstart = 20)),
    glanced = map(kmeans_results, glance)
  ) |>
  unnest(cols = c(glanced))

ggplot(elbow_1990, aes(x = k, y = tot.withinss)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  labs(title = "Elbow Plot for 1990 Sustainability Data",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)", 
       y = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplot(elbow_2015, aes(x = k, y = tot.withinss)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  labs(title = "Elbow Plot for 2015 Sustainability Data",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)", 
       y = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares") +
  theme_minimal()


sustain_1990_kmeans5 <- sustain_1990_std |>
  kmeans(centers = 5, nstart = 20)
sustain_2015_kmeans5 <- sustain_2015_std |>
  kmeans(centers = 5, nstart = 20)

sustain_1990_c5 <- augment(sustain_1990_kmeans5, sustainability1990) |>
  rename(cluster_1990 = .cluster)
sustain_2015_c5 <- augment(sustain_2015_kmeans5, sustainability2015) |>
  rename(cluster_2015 = .cluster)

# comparing clusters
clusters_1990 <- sustain_1990_c5 |>
  select(`Country Name`, cluster_1990)
clusters_2015 <- sustain_2015_c5 |>
  select(`Country Name`, cluster_2015)

cluster_comparison <- clusters_1990 |>
  inner_join(clusters_2015, by = "Country Name")
cluster_comparison

# visualization choice: scatterplot matrix
# for standardized 1990 cluster data
sustain_1990_c5 |>
  rename (
      renew_energy_consume = 
      "Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)",
      renew_electric_output = 
      "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
      electric_prod_oil = 
        "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)", 
      electric_prod_coal = 
        "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)"
    ) |>
  select(`renew_energy_consume`, `renew_electric_output`, `electric_prod_oil`, 
         `electric_prod_coal`, `cluster_1990`) |>
  ggpairs(aes(color = cluster_1990)
        , upper = list(continuous = "blank")
        , progress = FALSE) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

# for standardized 2015 cluster data
sustain_2015_c5 |>
  rename (
      renew_energy_consume = 
        "Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)",
      renew_electric_output = 
        "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
      electric_prod_oil = 
        "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)", 
      electric_prod_coal = 
        "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)"
    ) |>
  select(`renew_energy_consume`, `renew_electric_output`, `electric_prod_oil`, 
         `electric_prod_coal`, `cluster_2015`) |>
  ggpairs(aes(color = cluster_2015)
        , upper = list(continuous = "blank")
        , progress = FALSE) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))


```

```{r}
#| label: climate_long
#Create a version with all years in one column
climate_long <- climate1 |> 
  # 1) Filter for the four indicators in the image
  filter(
    `Indicator Name` %in% c(
      "Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)",
      "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
      "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)",
      "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)",
      "Electricity production from natural gas sources (% of total)"
    )
  ) |> 
  # 2) Keep only the essential columns
  select(
    "Country Code",
    "Country Name",
    "Indicator Name",
    matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}$")
  ) |> 
  
  mutate(across(matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}$"), as.numeric)) |> 
  # 5) Pivot longer to get Year and Value
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}$"),
    names_to  = "Year",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |> 
  # 6) Pivot wider to separate each indicator into its own column
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = `Indicator Name`,
    values_from = Value
  ) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year))

names(climate_long) <- c("Country Code", "Country Name", "Year",
                         "Renew_Cons", "Renew_Elec",   "Oil_Elec", "Gas_Elec",
                         "Coal_Elec")


write_rds(climate_long, "Data/climate_long.rds")


```
